role.description: Role of the connection (SUBSCRIBER, PUBLISHER, MODERATOR). Defaults to PUBLISHER.

data.description: Arbitrary data associated with the connection, usually JSON string.

kurentoOptions.description: Kurento Media Server specific options for the connection.
